name: Zeehan Current
scope: Winter Zeehan component from the western Bass Strait approach, southward off western Tasmania, around its southern tip and toward the southern east coast. Regional gate coordinates are OSW choices. Excludes the South Australian segment, East Australian Current and offshore eddy excursions; not the full western/southern Australian boundary-flow system.
layer: Upper-ocean shelf-edge reference geography; no fixed-depth or velocity-derived axis.
time_convention: Source's winter boundary-flow component convention; not a simultaneous observed trajectory or guaranteed year-round path.
source_locator: Ridgway and Condie (2004), section 9 paragraph 58: Zeehan flow along western Tasmania, beyond its southern tip to the southern east coast; paragraph 57 defines preceding South Australian component.
source_citation: Ridgway and Condie (2004), The 5500-km-long boundary flow off western and southern Australia, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans 109, C04017, doi:10.1029/2003JC001921.
source_license: Factual geography only; no source prose, figure, source curve or velocity field packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW chooses coarse offshore waypoints and regional start/end gates; no source-published axis or exact nomenclature boundary is traced. Southern east-coast termination remains a regional convention.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Shorter convention ending offshore of the southern tip; omits the source-described east-coast continuation.

scenario_rule: Southern-tip and southern-east-coast termination conventions crossed with three longitude offsets (-0.15/0/+0.15 degrees) and independent endpoint latitude shifts (-0.25/0/+0.25 degrees): 54 editorial scenarios, not empirical uncertainty.
remaining_gates: Scientific review of Zeehan component gates and southern east-coast continuation.
